{"consolidated_memory":"
ANALYTICS/ETL/ROLLUP.SQL - THREE DOUBLE-COUNTING INCIDENTS

File: analytics/etl/rollup.sql (analytics side)
Problem across all three: double counting in daily rollup, signal is totals larger than source table
Repro: rerun the rollup for a day already loaded
Stack: SQL; covering check is rollup reconciliation check in CI

OCCASION 1: 2026-04-02 - Corporate proxy traffic
Context: double counting only occurred for traffic through corporate proxy
Root cause: error swallowed by bare except handler
Fix: narrowed the exception handler to let the failure propagate
PR: #1138 on branch fix/double-counting-1
Result: reclaimed 20 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 2: 2026-04-14 - Staging read replica
Context: double counting only occurred on staging read replica
Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind lazy relation
Fix: prefetched the relation in a single query
PR: #3043 on branch fix/double-counting-2
Result: job finished in 10 minutes instead of 9 hours

OCCASION 3: 2026-07-15 - Large tenant keys
Context: double counting only occurred for tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
Root cause: connection pool exhaustion under burst load
Fix: raised the pool ceiling and put a bounded wait queue in front of it
PR: #6048 on branch fix/double-counting-4
Result: stopped writing 77 duplicate rows per day
"}
